newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland soon to sell Celuloza, Kruszwica stakes.
newsitem.headline: Poland soon to sell Celuloza, Kruszwica stakes.

text.p: Poland should quickly complete the privatisations of paper plant Celuloza Swiecie SA and edible fats maker Kruszwica SA, the head of privatisation at the treasury ministry said on Thursday.
"In the nearest future the privatisation of Celuloza Swiecie and Kruszwica should be finished," Adam Kowalczyk told a news conference.

The treasury ministry has been in talks on selling a 65 percent stake of Celuloza to South Africa's Mondi, a unit of Anglo-American Corp of South Africa, which along with Austrian subsidiary Frantschach AG won the right to be the sole bidder in the Celuloza privatisation tender.
The ministry is selling up to 46 percent of Kruszwica.
Kowalczyk also said that around the end of the third quarter the initial public offerings of appliance maker Polar SA and tourist and hotel firm Orbis SA should take place.
